summary: Add self-contained weekly.ps1 and monthly.ps1 report scripts in examples/weekly-report/.
reason: Three fragmented scripts that shipped with the original print (weekly_fetch.ps1, weekly_report.ps1, run_weekly.ps1) required manual wiring together and used broken TAB-text parsing; replaced with two self-contained scripts that parse the sql command's JSON output correctly and produce both CSV and formatted XLSX output.
validated_outcome: Scripts resolve the CLI binary from PATH or local build, parse sql --json output via ConvertFrom-Json, and export Excel via COM.
